text:
Nina (People Ops): Quick coordination thread for Samir Patel (start Mon). Hes flying in Sun night, asked for laptop to be shipped to hotel and wants a Gujarati interpreter for day-1. Passport expired; says he has a Canadian PR card + Ontario health card. Can we confirm I-9 plan + shipping?

Alex (Recruiter): Samir prefers hotel pickup to avoid extra travel but can swing by HQ if needed. Hes available 10:00am for an in-person I-9. Asked if laptop can be held at front desk with mobile verification only (no signature).

Lina (Onboarding): Canadian PR card satisfies List A so that works for I-9. Expired passport not acceptable. Two paths: in-person 10:00am with Gujarati interpreter booked, OR remote NotaryNow session (candidate must be physically in US during remote signing). Please have him upload front/back of PR card + secondary ID to secure portal by EOD Fri.

BGCheck Desk: Vendor note 11DD without SSN on file some county-level checks may take longer; we can run ID-first verifications. Consent needed now to avoid blocking.

Samir (candidate): Confirming I can do 10:00am at office. I will upload PR card pics tonight and sign BG consent. Hotel pickup is fine but prefer front desk hold for pickup. Also thanks for Gujarati interpreter 60a

Nina (People Ops): Plan: 1) Book 10:00am I-9 drop-in with Gujarati interpreter, 2) If Samir cancels last-minute, run NotaryNow remote that evening (link in invite), 3) IT to label package for front desk "Hold for Guest Pickup" and include Samir mobile. Lina will send secure upload link.

IT-bot: Shipping OK with exact hold-for label below. If pickup at hotel, include mobile and "Front Desk - Guest Pickup" text. Asset held until AUP signed.

```
Hold for: Samir Patel / Redwood Inference
Marriott Union Square
Assign to: Front Desk - Guest Pickup
Guest check-in name: Samir Patel
Mobile: +1 415-555-0188
```

IT-bot: Also: AUP link will be emailed; VPN/profile will be staged but not activated until asset pickup and AUP ack.

Alex (Recruiter): Samir asked a good question: "If my PR card is fine, do you still need my SSN to start payroll?" Answer: we can provision payroll as soon as I-9 is completed; SSN can be submitted later but payroll might need it for tax docs.

Lina (Onboarding): Adding checklist to invite body:
1) Upload PR card (front/back) to secure portal
2) Upload one secondary government ID (provincial health card or license)
3) Sign background check consent
4) Complete AUP before asset handoff

NotaryNow-bot: Remote sessions available 7am-9pm PST. Reminder: remote I-9 requires candidate to be physically located in the US and present original documents to camera. Schedule: https://notarynow.example/schedule

BGCheck Desk: Once consent and PR card are uploaded well kick off ID verification and mark SSN pending. International address flagged may add 48-96h for full vendor clear.

Samir (candidate): Uploaded PR card pics and signed consent. Prefers hotel pickup but will come to 10:00am if IT prefers handoff in-office. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

Nina (People Ops): Perfect 44d Lina, please confirm interpreter and finalize invite. IT, please proceed with hotel hold label and AUP email. Closing once we have docs + booking.

Lina (Onboarding): Gujarati interpreter confirmed for 10:00am. Calendar invite sent with NotaryNow fallback and checklist.

IT-bot: Laptop queued for hotel hold-for. AUP email sent to Samir. Will mark asset ready-on-arrival.

BGCheck Desk: We started ID verification. SSN pending. Will update thread if additional docs requested.

Nina (People Ops): Great job team 389
